name: 保险（价值/损失/重置）评估

map.房产保险评估工具，计算重置成本、实际价值、保险价值和损失赔偿金额，支持比例赔偿和: A property insurance valuation tool computing replacement cost, actual cash value, insurable value and loss payment, under both proportional and first-loss indemnity.
map.📖 查看「保险（价值/损失/重置）评估 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Insurance Valuation (Value / Loss / Replacement) User Guide"
map.重置成本为重新建造相同房产的成本: Replacement cost is the cost of rebuilding an equivalent property
map.实际价值=重置成本×(1-折旧率)，折旧按使用年限计算: Actual cash value = replacement cost × (1 − depreciation rate), with depreciation by elapsed life
map.比例赔偿：投保不足时按比例赔偿，建议足额投保: Proportional indemnity: under-insurance pays out pro rata, so insure for the full value
map.第一危险赔偿：损失在保险金额以内全额赔偿: First-loss indemnity: losses within the sum insured are paid in full
map.📚 深度解析：保险价值与重置成本评估: 📚 In-depth: Insurable Value and Replacement Cost
map.投保前确定财产实际价值与保险金额。: Set the actual value and the sum insured before taking out cover.
map.出险后按赔偿方式计算赔付金额。: After a claim, compute the payout under the chosen indemnity method.
map.判断足额投保还是不足额投保以避免比例赔偿。: Check whether cover is full or partial to avoid proportional settlement.
map.重置成本 200 万、已用 10 年、耐用 50 年 → 折旧率 20%、实际价: Replacement cost 2 million yuan, 10 years used of a 50-year life gives a depreciation rate of 20% and an actual cash value of 1.6 million yuan; if only 1.2 million yuan is insured (60% of value), a 500,000 yuan loss is settled proportionally at 300,000 yuan.
map.若选第一危险赔偿方式且投保 120 万，50 万损失在保额内全额赔 50 万，超: Under first-loss indemnity with a sum insured of 1.2 million yuan, a 500,000 yuan loss is paid in full and only the excess is excluded; it suits cases where the sum insured is close to actual value.
map.为什么要足额投保？: Why insure for the full value?
map.不足额投保会触发比例赔偿（赔付款=损失×投保比例），省下的保费远不够覆盖少赔的部: Under-insurance triggers proportional settlement (payout = loss × insurance ratio), and the premium saved is far less than the shortfall in cover.
map.重置成本和实际价值区别？: How do replacement cost and actual cash value differ?
map.重置成本是重建同样房屋的花销，实际价值还要扣除折旧，保险理赔以实际价值或约定方式: Replacement cost is what rebuilding the same house costs; actual cash value also deducts depreciation. Claims settle on actual cash value or the agreed basis.
map.房产保险评估工具计算重置成本、实际价值、保险价值和损失赔偿金额，支持比例赔偿和第: The property insurance tool computes replacement cost, actual cash value, insurable value and loss payment under both proportional and first-loss indemnity, helping set a sensible sum insured and estimate recovery.
